name: evisions
description: Safety baseline for Codex CLI: hooks that block recursive deletion, destructive git in every form, secret reads, downloaded code run in a shell, edits of env files, credentials, shell startup files and Codex's own configuration, and nested codex runs that switch the safety layer off, plus a session protocol for handling a block. The Claude Code kit's skills and agents are not part of the Codex package.

interface.shortDescription: Blocks destructive commands, secret reads and edits of Codex's own configuration
interface.longDescription: A PreToolUse check on every shell command and every apply_patch edit blocks recursive deletion, destructive git (force push, reset --hard, checkout --, clean -f, branch -D, commit --no-verify, -n and -a, also behind git -C), reads of env files and credentials, downloaded code piped into a shell, edits of env files, credentials, shell startup files and the Codex configuration, rules, hooks and plugins, and nested codex runs with bypass flags. A SessionStart hook tells the agent how to handle a block. The hooks run only after the user trusts them in Codex.
defaultPrompt: What does the evisions safety check block?
